mechanisms.description: Create an account at https://pexafy.com/signup/, then create a key at https://pexafy.com/dashboard/api-keys/create/. The key is issued immediately: no application form, no review queue, no per-download callback to implement. There is no programmatic key-issuance endpoint yet.

methods.bootstrap: Create a key from the dashboard, then send it in the x-api-key header. A Bearer token is accepted on the same routes.

credentials.rotation: Create a new key and revoke the old one from https://pexafy.com/dashboard/api-keys/ at any time.

scopes.notes: Keys created from the dashboard carry read and write: read covers search, photo lookups and facets; write covers the caller's own collections. Admin and crawler roles are internal and are never granted to user keys.

steps.description: Unauthenticated health check — confirms the service is reachable before spending a key.
First authenticated call: a natural-language search returning photos from every source in one schema.
Read the quota the key has consumed, so an agent can pace itself.

economics.freeTier: 5,000 requests/month, 1 API key, no card required

gaps: API keys are created from the web dashboard; there is no programmatic key-issuance endpoint yet.
